The Los Angeles Dodgers are hosting the Philadelphia Phillies for a three-game series, with the action getting underway at 10:15 p.m. ET on Friday, May 29.

Los Angeles has not played a game this season while listed as the underdog. The Phillies have put together a 23-16 record in games they were listed as the moneyline favorite (winning 59% of those games). This season, Philadelphia has been the underdog 14 times and won four, or 28.6%, of those games.
